title: proration
description: The result of a plan upgrade/downgrade proration calculation (issue #94). `rounding_rule` is always the const `half_up_minor_unit`: OMES uses HALF-UP rounding in integer minor units, never banker's rounding (round-half-to-even) and never floating point - see lib/omes/py/jobs/payments.py's round_half_up() and docs/control-center-contracts.md 'Deterministic rounding rule' for the rationale (predictability for a human-reviewed manual credit/charge beats banker's rounding's long-run bias cancellation, which matters more for high-volume automated trading than for a subscription proration a support agent may need to explain to a customer). `net_amount_minor` is `new_amount_minor - unused_amount_minor` and may be negative (a credit) or positive (an additional charge).
